en: The image shows the address side of an old Spanish postcard. The card is yellowed with age and has a red 10-cent postage stamp in the upper right corner with a circular black postmark. At the top center, printed text reads "TARJETA POSTAL / UNION POSTAL UNIVERSAL / ESPAÑA." Below, in neat cursive handwriting, the address is written to Sr. D. José H. Hurtado de Mendoza y Pérez Galdós at Hotel San Quintín in Santander. There is no visible photograph or illustration on this side, only text and postal markings.
